name: The Paradoxical Turnabout
source:
Vince is on the brink of losing his legal career. All hope seems lost when an omniscient ghost unexpectedly shows up before him and asks him to solve her murder. To aid him on his mission, she grants him the Time Keeper, an enigmatic device that can launch any piece of evidence to the past in the blink of an eye.

[From [url=https://www.aaonline.fr/forum/viewtopic.php?t=13901]AAOnline[/url]]
translation:
文斯的律师生涯正濒临断送的边缘。就在万念俱灰之际，一只全知全能的幽灵出人意料地出现在他面前，委托他侦破自己遇害的命案。为了协助他完成使命，幽灵赐予了他神秘装置“时光守望者”——只需眨眼之间，便能将任何证物传送回过去。

[摘自[url=https://www.aaonline.fr/forum/viewtopic.php?t=13901]AAOnline[/url]]
